# Build undirected neighbor sets from adjacency (CSV already has both directions)
boroughs = sorted(df['borough'].tolist())
n = len(boroughs)

neighbor_sets = {b: set() for b in boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    ne = row['neighbor']
    if b in neighbor_sets and ne in neighbor_sets:

        neighbor_sets[ne].add(b)

# Create row-standardized weight matrix W (n x n)

    neighs = list(neighbor_sets[b])
    k = len(neighs)

print("Std gas:", std_x)

# Compute spatial lag

# Compute local Moran's I
